title: DevOps Engineer
description:
About the role
We are hiring a DevOps Engineer for our Platform team (Amsterdam, Netherlands).

What you will do
- Set up monitoring, alerting and incident response
- Help development teams ship safely and often
- Run and improve our cloud infrastructure

What you bring
- At least 2 years of relevant experience
- Solid working knowledge of CI/CD, Docker, Ansible and Kubernetes

Nice to have
- Prometheus, Linux and Nginx
